title: Queen for the Back Rank
setup: Black's bishop on a5 is the only piece watching d8, and its king sits behind two pawns on h8.
hint: Your rook wants the eighth rank, but one black piece covers the entry square. What can you offer it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8+}} is a deflection. The king is walled in by its own pawns on g7 and h7, so the bishop has to take: {{Bxd8}} is the only legal move. Now the d-file is clear behind it, and {{Rxd8#}} finishes on the back rank.
